## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] Dashboard build or relevant smoke test completed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Database migration included when required
- [ ] No `.env`, database, browser profile, cookie, log, diagnostic, backup, or media file included
- [ ] Publishing, destructive-operation, and rollback risks reviewed
